items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: word got to me that Bobby Paine wanted to see me

ctx.x: Oh yeah, for a long time, but he was Buhaina you know, he was still Art Blakey; that was his Muslim name. I think the band all gave their notice, I'm not sure. Anyway, he asked Ira and I to come up and sit in, and we did -- so he taught us our names for future reference, and not long after that, I'm hanging out -- Ira and I went down to Hannibal, and Wilbur Campbell and Eddie Baker Missouri, and play a little weekend gig, and when I come back, we were all hanging out around the Cotton Club -- that was the…
And it was something like a [clan] house of musicians. See, I didn't have no permanent address then; I was still chasing that powder, like a fool, but that was my lifestyle, and I'll
